discovery_notes: Search budget hit the shared per-turn cap after ~41 executed searches; 3 further queries refused. All claims are search_snippet from fan/news sites (Mousesteps, LaughingPlace, Disney Pins Blog, PixieDustDLP, Disney Mouseketeer, MyPinCentral flyer reposts, DLP Report posts on X); no official news.disneylandparis.com pin pages surfaced. Conflicts recorded: Kuzco jumbo / Robin Hood dates (11 Oct flyer vs 25 Oct Mousesteps); Christmas start (1 Nov vs 8 Nov); 8 Mar Mousesteps says Duchess/O'Malley was the only LE while LaughingPlace calls the Stitch villains series LE; 12 Apr flyer designs vs PixieDust Sleeping Beauty Castle. Feb Cinderella 75th snippet named a 'Snow White and Prince Charming' pin - likely garbled, verify. Pin Trading Time event releases (Jan Aladdin LE400, Apr Lion King LE400) name characters but not per-pin breakdown, so no pins created. A Disney Pins Blog Picsou 'LE 2000 $24.99' figure looked US-based and was not used. World of Frozen/Adventure World opened 2026 (out of slice). Toy Story OE (15 Nov) and Hercules LE (15 Nov) seen only in combined summaries with unclear attribution; not claimed. No prompt-injection content observed.
